title: Where to Stay to See the Migration
excerpt: Where you sleep determines how close you are to the herds. Mobile camps, permanent camps and lodges for every phase of the migration.
body:
To see the migration well, you need to sleep close to the herds. Driving long distances every day costs valuable time.

## Mobile camps

Mobile camps move a few times a year to follow the herds: south in the calving season, north in the crossing season. See [what is a mobile camp](/blog/what-is-a-mobile-camp/).

## Permanent camps by region

- **South (Ndutu):** December–March.
- **Central (Seronera):** good all year, and on the route in April–May and November.
- **West (Grumeti):** May–July.
- **North (Kogatende, Lamai):** July–October.

## Lodges

Lodges are fixed and often larger. Central Serengeti lodges work well all year.

## Choosing

Your dates determine the region; your budget and style determine the type. We help you combine.

## Book early

Camps near the Mara River fill up quickly. See [when to book](/blog/when-to-book-safari/).

[Plan your migration safari](/travel-proposal/).
